mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the unemployment rate below 5% signals a tightening labor market that will drive wage inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the Fed tightens policy.
failure_condition: UNRATE drops below 5% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production over a 6-month period, measured by the year-over-year change in INDPRO, signals a supply-driven slowdown that will weigh on S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y INDPRO growth is negative but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy stance that will weigh on S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS exceeds 4% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) rise by more than 10% year-over-year and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 6%, it signals a strong consumer demand environment that will boost S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Trigger condition met but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment (PAYEMS) grows by more than 200,000 jobs per month for three consecutive months, it signals a tightening labor market that will drive wage inflation and lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Trigger condition met but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is rising and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) is above 3%, it signals a high inflation environment that will lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Trigger condition met but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP (GDPC1) is in a year-over-year decline and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is rising, it signals a weakening economy that will lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 y-o-y change < 0% AND UNRATE rising
failure_condition: Trigger condition met but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 40% of triggered instances.
